Deltana 88MR-15, Satin Nickel Wall Mounted Magazine Rack

This Satin Nickel magazine rack, it features a modern deign that will look great in any contemporary decor. Made by Deltana with the attention to quality for which they are known. Not only good for the bathroom, it is perfect for waiting rooms of all kinds and for the kid's bedroom to hold their favorite books.

Shop more of the Deltana 88 Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Deltana 88MR-15 Magazine Rack:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Center to Center Length: 10-1/2"
  • Overall Top Bar Length:13-1/8"
  • Overall Bottom Bar Length: 6"
  • Overall Height: 8-3/4"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Overall Projection: 3-1/8"
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Deltana 88MR Magazine Rack Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: (1) satin nickel finish magazine rack, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.



**Discontinued. See available Bathroom Hardware
